desc:
🩸 BLOOD UPDATE: Dummies now bleed blocky cartoon blood – shoot them in the legs and they crawl away from you! (Blood can be turned off in Settings.)

Smash, launch and knock over wobbly ragdoll dummies – every hit uses real active ragdoll physics! Dummies stumble, try to catch their balance and crash to the ground in hilarious ways.

🥊 SANDBOX: Dummies all over the map. Punch, kick, shove them off rooftops or pin them to walls.
⚔️ WAVES: Brawlers attack in waves – knock them out or push them off. Falling hurts!
🔫 19 WEAPONS: From fists and frying pans to the minigun and the orbital laser – unlock them with K.O.s.
🗺️ 7 MAPS: City, Construction Site, Backyard, Warehouse, Rooftops, Sky Stairs and Subway.
💥 EVENTS: Nuke, Dummy Rain, Zero Gravity, Firestorm, Deep Freeze and Black Hole.
⭐ Earn money for every fall and combo and level up through 10 ranks.

Play in English or German!
